% Derived from the tkz-fct manual's documented gnuplot expression grammar.
% This case isolates the finite-sample pole behavior of \tkzFct.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tkz-fct}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \tkzInit[xmin=-2,xmax=2,ymin=-5,ymax=5]
  \tkzGrid[color=gray!30]
  \tkzAxeXY
  \tkzFct[color=red,domain=-2:2,samples=81]{tan(x)}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
